z6x7vmhp.sourceDescription: Bring the beauty of a natural pine tree into your home with this realistic artificial Christmas tree, featuring lush branches that create a full, traditional festive display when fully shaped. A sturdy metal stand provides reliable support to keep the tree upright throughout the festive season. Designed for repeated seasonal use, the tree can be disassembled into four parts for convenient storage after Christmas. Suitable for homes, offices, commercial spaces and festive events, it provides an attractive centrepiece ready to decorate with your favourite baubles, lights and ornaments. x87f447n.sourceDescription: Looking for something different this Christmas? Our pre-lit Black Iridescence tree offers a trendy alternative to traditional Xmas trees. Full, bushy, and packed with pre-strung warm white lights, this black Christmas tree recreates the stunning look of the naturally growing Black Pine (Pinus Nigra). The pre-lit Black Iridescence, however, has incredible eye-catching strips of clear iridescent film in the foliage, giving your tree an elegant dark green shimmer. It's a real treat for the eyes when combined with glittering Christmas decorations! Pictures shows 7ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. pq2n4ckr.sourceDescription: This artificial Christmas tree is sure to become a magical eye-catcher among your Christmas decorations and create a unique Christmas atmosphere! Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

j46m6aq8.sourceDescription: Welcome guests in style this Christmas with our Micro LED Lighted Christmas Wreath. We've designed each wreath with a metal frame in a stylish, modern silver colour. • Choose from a 38cm wreath with 480 micro LEDs or 50cm wreath with 860 micro LEDs • Designed with a stylish, modern silver metal frame to easily hang on a front door or wall • Beautifully illuminated by warm white micro LEDs to create a warm, welcoming feature • UK mains powered with a 5m clear cable and IP20 rated plug (for indoor sockets only) • Timer function to automatically light up at the same time every night (6hrs on/18hrs off) Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Diameter: 50cm • Material: Metal • Weight: 0.7kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Ensure the product is securely positioned before use. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL
